GenAiPlugin.description: Reads the current field values of an industry variant section and the matching industry research brief (problem, use case, solution, proof points). Call this first before proposing any drafted copy.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Call this action to read the current field values of the industry variant section the editor has open, plus that industry's research brief. Use the returned brief (problem/useCase/solution/proofLine) to ground any drafted copy, never invent a client fact the brief does not support.
